apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. PT restriction on overhead pressing is a clinical call, not a preference — it overrides "I know my body." I won't program it.

I'll keep Wednesday's Upper Body Strength session built around rows, pulldowns, and pressing variants that don't load the shoulder overhead. If you want, I can check that session's current exercise list and swap anything overhead out.
